headline: Forced labour allegations at Brown Textiles mills
content: Investigation found evidence of debt bondage arrangements for migrant workers at facilities in Tamil Nadu. Workers reported being unable to leave or repay debts.

headline: NGO report: wage theft at Brown Textiles
content: Audit revealed systematic underpayment and excessive overtime without compensation in violation of wage agreements

headline: Freedom of association concerns
content: Workers report union harassment and restricted communication with organizing body

headline: News report about Law Knitting Mill
content: Factory faces scrutiny from union regarding worker compensation practices
